identitySignals: Name matches a registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit in Oakland, CA: 'Cypress Mandela Training Center', EIN 80-0123340 (ProPublica Nonprofit Explorer), matching the agenda's Oakland, CA

Organization's own website (cypressmandela.org) gives an Oakland address and describes trades career training and education, matching OUSD's Linked Learning / career technical education (CTE) grant-funded 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts
ProPublica lists the NTEE category as vocational and technical schools, consistent with CTE-funded services
research.notes: Website footer also names 'Cypress Mandela, Inc.'; legal name given here follows the IRS/ProPublica record. No California SOS or SAM.gov lookup done (web search budget exhausted). Website does not mention OUSD directly; match rests on name, location and subject-matter fit.

profile.summary: Cypress Mandela Training Center is an Oakland nonprofit that provides career training and education in the construction trades. It aims to open pathways to livable-wage careers for people in underserved communities. Its work also includes environmental stewardship efforts.

sources.title: Cypress Mandela Training Center - Nonprofit Explorer - ProPublica

review.notes: The unusual name, the Oakland location and the vocational-training NTEE category match the agenda name, Oakland and the CTE and Linked Learning grant-funded contracts, and the ProPublica record and website agree on the name. Contact details match the website; the site only names 'the trades' generally and mentions construction in a graduate testimonial, so 'construction trades' in the summary is a mild but reasonable inference.
